_about: CL-272 (D-94): the world's beds from Ocular's field recordings (The Provence, Countryside Vol.1), each made a seamless 24 s loop (tools/pack-make.py, loop). Picked from the libraries' descriptions (no traffic, dogs, people or bells) and the steadiest stretch of each recording (no event that would repeat every 24 s). Sound rule: immersive (the valley around him). Kept as they are: his night wind, the lake shore (the packs' water is the sea), the frogs (the packs' are a rainforest's). The vault's door, the relay hatch's latch and the field notes' paper were only synthesized: Puncture's metal-slam mechanism stems, Mechanica's latches, Utility's note sheets. The hikers' camera (GP-19974's clip): Aperture's Canon EOS T7i, the screen flipped open and the power switch.
